# MouseY <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
MouseY:Int32
```

**Returns:** The vertical position of the pointer.

## Description

The vertical position of the pointer in the graphics buffer, from 0 at the top to `GraphicsHeight() - 1`. See [MouseX](MouseX).

## Differences

* The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.
